description: Start watching a product for the signed-in user (product URL or id, optional target price). Sends a confirmation email; this tool does not confirm it. Requires a Bearer API key or session token.

lang.description: Output language: "en" or "tr". Defaults to the user's language when the client says it, otherwise English.

product.description: Product id or shop URL to watch.

query.description: A name to search if you do not have a link yet.

name: add_watch
title: Add a watch
